Decompilation of the main function (_WinMain@16) shows it loads the system library 'hdwwiz.cpl' and invokes the 'AddHardwareWizard' export. The embedded manifest correctly identifies the program and specifies the 'requireAdministrator' execution level, which is standard for hardware configuration tools. There are no indicators of malicious behavior, unauthorized persistence, or suspicious network activity.
